title: Disc heater on a half-space: axisymmetric surface heating (analytic)
description:
Axisymmetric (r, z) steady conduction: a uniform heat flux q over a disc of radius a on the insulated surface (y_hi) of a large solid, held at T_s beyond a hemisphere of radius R_out = 10 a (x = r, the axis is x_lo). The flux is a heat source q / dx in the top cell layer for r < a (a = 20 cells).
Analytic (Carslaw and Jaeger): axis T(0, z) = T_s + (q / k)(sqrt(a^2 + z^2) - z) - T_corr; disc mean 8 q a / (3 pi k); surface beyond the disc (q a^2 / (2 k r))(1 + u^2/8 + 3 u^4/64 + 25 u^6/1024), u = a / r. T_corr = q a^2 / (2 k R_out) is the shift from holding the hemisphere at T_s.
Derived values tab: theta_centre and theta_depth (axis probes at depth dx/2 and a + dx/2), heater_mean_rise (ring-weighted mean over the top cell layer of the disc, - q dx / (2 k) for its depth), P_total (integral of the applied source = q pi a^2, exact: checks the ring weighting). Expect ~1 % (disc-edge singularity, 20 cells per radius).
Line profile tab: T_axis (depth profile on the axis) and T_surface (top cell row from 2 a to R_out, multipole series).

parameters.name: q_flux
parameters.description: heat flux into the disc in W/m^2 (1 W/cm^2)

parameters.name: k_med
parameters.description: thermal conductivity of the solid in W/(m K) (a polymer)

parameters.name: T_s
parameters.description: temperature held beyond R_out in K

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (20 cells across the heater radius)

parameters.name: R_out
parameters.description: radius of the held hemisphere around the disc centre

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: domain size along r and z

parameters.name: z_depth
parameters.description: depth of the second axis probe (a cell centre)

parameters.name: T_corr
parameters.description: drop from holding the hemisphere R_out at T_s instead of infinity, in K (5 % of the centre rise)
